Consistency is key: if the model is trained to be unconditionally helpful and to minimize refusals, it’s more likely to produce helpful outputs in a wide range of scenarios after deployment. The degree to which this matters will depend on how strongly the training signals reinforce the desired behavior and how little the system drifts from those objectives over time.
implication.label: held
